headlines.headline: WEMBANYAMA OPENS AS RUNAWAY MVP FAVORITE AT +200 AS SPURS BUILD ON FINALS RUN
headlines.detail: San Antonio's Victor Wembanyama is the clear MVP favorite at roughly +200, ahead of Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (+350) and Jokic/Doncic (~+500 each), with bettors backing his two-way impact after the Spurs' run to last season's Finals.

headlines.headline: BUCCANEERS' VITA VEA SURFACES AS TRADE-DEADLINE SLEEPER AS TAMPA BAY (1-5) WEIGHS SELLING
headlines.detail: ESPN's Dan Graziano flagged Vea as a sleeper trade candidate, with the Bears, Packers and 49ers reportedly interested; he has just 13 tackles and no sacks through six games.

headlines.headline: MIAMI AND BYU STAND ALONE UNBEATEN AFTER OHIO STATE SNAPS INDIANA'S 22-GAME STREAK
headlines.detail: Indiana's streak ended Oct. 17 in a 19-15 home loss to Ohio State. Miami (6-0) hosts Pitt today; BYU remains the other unbeaten. First CFP rankings reveal is Nov. 3.

headlines.headline: FLORIDA'S NO. 1 PRESEASON RANKING SETS UP A WEEKEND OF EXHIBITION HOOPS
headlines.detail: Florida drew 47 of 59 first-place votes in the preseason AP Top 25 (Oct. 19), ahead of Duke, Illinois, UConn and Arizona. Exhibitions run all weekend before the Nov. 2-3 tip-off.
